Name: Oded, Prophet of Samaria
Summary: Oded, a prophet of the LORD at Samaria, met Israel's returning host and warned that they had slain Judah in a rage reaching to heaven, and that keeping the captives would add to their own sin; the captives were then returned.
KeyStory: Oded told the host to deliver the captives again, for the fierce wrath of the LORD was upon them, and the men expressed by name clothed and fed the captives and carried the feeble to Jericho.
RelatedPeople: Ahaz, King of Judah; Pekah, Son of Remaliah
LifeLesson: A prophet's rebuke can turn plunder into mercy.
